messages:
incident-bot: Pager: gen-queue-eu-west: elevated error rate (5xx) detected. Severity: P1. Notifying @jamie (oncall), #eng-sre. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/gen-queue-eu

jamie (oncall): ack — joining bridge. creating short-lived channel and assigning incident lead.

kim (sre): joining. initial metric snapshot: 09:23–09:30 UTC saw 14% 5xx on gen-queue-eu-west, tail latency increased ~250ms -> 2s for embeddings. CPU on a subset of nodes at 98%, memory spiking.

ops-liaison: tagging comms — we need a customer-facing initial status page blurb. What is the scope?

jamie (oncall): short summary for comms: hosted embeddings/backends in eu-west partially degraded. Some requests returning 5xx; many still succeed but latency degraded. No report of data loss so far. Root cause under investigation (likely autoscaler + memory leak on runtime).

lee (comms): drafting initial status copy, please review quickly. Proposed text:

```
Initial update (09:35 UTC): We are investigating increased error rates and slowed responses for hosted embeddings in our eu-west region. Some requests may return errors (5xx) or experience higher latency. We are routing traffic and working on mitigation; this may impact a subset of customers using embeddings endpoints in EU. We will post updates every 30 minutes or sooner.
Affected services: Hosted embeddings (eu-west).
Customer impact: partial degradation; some requests failing or slower.
Next update: 10:05 UTC.
```

maya (product): add: call out no data loss and advise retry. Suggested line: "No data loss has been detected; clients can safely retry requests."

erin (legal): quick check — wording fine, avoid promising timeline. leave "we will post updates every 30 minutes or sooner." good.

kim (sre): ops note — enabling autoscaler override and draining a couple suspect nodes now, will also flip routing to standby pool in 5m.

jamie (oncall): approved. lee, please publish initial status with the copy edited to include maya's note. Confirm when live.

lee (comms): publishing now. Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/gen-queue-eu-west-1776549999 (internal preview up) 

incident-bot: Status page update posted by lee (comms): https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/gen-queue-eu-west-1776549999 (Initial)

kim (sre): 09:48 UTC — autoscaler override applied, drained 3 nodes, standby pool accepting ~40% of new connections. 5xx rate dropped to ~6%. Continuing telemetry.

ops-liaison: updating internal incident tracker with mitigation steps and runbook links. Please drop short bullet list for customers on next update about routing and mitigation.

lee (comms): drafting 10:05 UTC update. Candidate: 

```
Update (10:05 UTC): We have applied routing changes and taken a subset of nodes out of rotation to reduce errors. Error rates have decreased but some requests may still see higher latency. Engineers are continuing remediation and monitoring. Impact is reduced; scaled failover is in effect.
Next update: 10:35 UTC or sooner.
```

jamie (oncall): confirm — can we add a short TL;DR line: "Impact reduced, failover in place, no data loss."

lee (comms): added. Publishing update now.

incident-bot: Status page update posted by lee (comms): https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/gen-queue-eu-west-1776549999 (Update)

erin (legal): good to go.

kim (sre): 10:22 UTC — additional patch deployed to runtime to address memory regression. Monitoring for stability. 5xx rate <1.5% and trending down; tail latency near baseline.

ops-liaison: please prepare resolved copy if this stabilizes for 20 more minutes. Also coordinate with support for any customers who already reached out.

support note (ops-liaison): I pinged support triage to start cleanup workflow and identify impacted customers for outreach.

lee (comms): drafting resolved text for approval:

```
Resolved (10:45 UTC): We have implemented routing changes and a runtime patch which mitigated the elevated error rate and high latency observed in eu-west hosted embeddings. Error rates and latency have returned to normal levels. No customer data loss was detected. If you continue to experience issues, please contact support.
```

maya (product): +1 — also include a short engineering postmortem scheduled note: "Post-incident summary will be published in the next 24–48 hours."

erin (legal): approve publish.

jamie (oncall): confirmed: systems stable for 25 minutes, closing incident; please publish resolved.

lee (comms): publishing resolved now. https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/gen-queue-eu-west-1776549999 (Resolved)

incident-bot: Status page update posted by lee (comms): https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/gen-queue-eu-west-1776549999 (Resolved)

kim (sre): marking incident as resolved in runbook. scheduling root cause follow-up with infra and runtime teams for tomorrow.

jamie (oncall): thanks team. I'll file a short post-incident Slack summary + link to the playbook changes.

lee (comms): published resolved notice and queued follow-on email to enterprise contacts.

ops-liaison: closing bridge and handing over to follow-up owners. Good job everyone. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident 1776549999 closed by jamie (oncall)."
